clues.text: In the land of Uz lived this blameless, upright man who feared God and shunned evil.
Satan told the LORD that God had placed a hedge around this man, his household and all he owned.
A messenger told him a mighty desert wind struck a house's four corners, and it collapsed on the young people.
He said naked he came from his mother's womb and would return naked; the LORD gave and has taken away.
Satan infected him with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
His friends sat on the ground with him seven days and nights, saying nothing, because his suffering was intense.
The LORD asked this man where he was when the foundations of the earth were laid.
